name: Eminence EMN claim/award bypasses bonding-curve reserve accounting
summary: EminenceCurrency prices buy() and sell() from a Bancor curve over (totalSupply, reserveBalance), but its external claim(address,uint256) and award(address,uint256) burn and mint EMN without any matching change to reserveBalance. The Eminence AAVE sub-currency, made a gamemaster by its own constructor through EMN.addGM, calls exactly those two functions, so converting EMN into eAAVE cut EMN's totalSupply while the DAI reserve accounting stayed put and raised the redemption price of every remaining EMN. Under a flash loan the attacker bought EMN, burned half of it into eAAVE, sold the rest back at the inflated rate, minted the EMN back out of eAAVE and sold again, three rounds per transaction. The violated invariant is that the curve's supply and reserve variables must move together on every supply change.
notes: EminenceCurrency is immutable with no proxy, upgrade path or delegatecall dispatch; the runtime installed by this creation is byte-identical at block 10954410, 14 hours later.

Exact victim depletion measured from the DAI Transfer logs of the three exploit receipts: 165,515,253.962728662 DAI out of the EMN curve contract against 150,363,955.060136639 DAI in, a net 15,151,298.902592022871481394 DAI. The gross-in figure is dominated by flash-loan principal that was repaid inside each transaction and is therefore netted out as an attacker-supplied input. EMN's own DAI balance fell from 14,786,580.432831687370238855 to 81,325.093766019990770332 over blocks 10954410 to 10954419, 446,043.56 DAI less than the attacker took, because unrelated users kept buying into the curve during those blocks. DAI is valued at par. The attacker later returned 8,000,000 DAI to the deployer; under METHODOLOGY that recovery does not reduce gross victim depletion.

The Eminence contracts were deployed to mainnet unannounced and unfinished, but they were live, permissionless and held roughly 14.8M DAI of user deposits at the time of the exploit, so the victim is a real deployed execution context with a complete onchain deployment anchor.

The sub-currency Eminence AAVE 0xc08f38f43adb64d16fe9f9efcc2949d9eddec198 is a separate EminenceCurrency deployment that supplies the calls into the defective functions. It is not carried as a second target because the broken accounting is entirely in the EMN contract; eAAVE only uses the API as intended.
